scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @sentinelpay/shared && npm run build --workspace @sentinelpay/api && npm run build --workspace @sentinelpay/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @sentinelpay/shared && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && node --test --test-isolation=none audit-output/test-build/tests/*.test.js
scripts.test:contracts: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspace @sentinelpay/contracts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:browser: npm run build --workspace @sentinelpay/shared && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && playwright test
